- **Total CityRide spending: $647.11.** I added up the 20 CityRide charges in MyBank, from Aug 17 to Oct 12, 2026.
- **Average weekly commute cost: about $80.89.** That's $647.11 spread over the 8 weeks those charges cover. It includes every CityRide trip, so airport and leisure rides are in there too. Commute trips alone would cost less per week.
- **Sheet updated:** rows 11–13 of the Spending Dashboard now read "Most common route" / "Home to Work (Home - Work commute)", "Total CityRide spending" / 647.11 and "Avg weekly commute cost" / 80.89.
